verdict.rationale: Qodo supports natural-language interaction primarily through PR discussion threads ("Discuss or dismiss a finding") and its Agentic Toolbox/CLI/MCP, which let users or agents issue natural-language-style requests to review code, retrieve findings, and fetch rules. Community confirms a real 'Qodo Command CLI' with natural-language-driven agentic workflows and permission controls. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a chat/command syntax showing natural-language input, first-party examples of NL commands beyond discuss/dismiss, and independent hands-on validation of the CLI's NL capabilities.
